name: 12 Play Testers
description: Managed Google Play closed testing for Android apps: 12 human testers on real devices, using the app every day for 14 consecutive days, so a new developer account can apply for production access. Operated by KubeAI. Every order starts as pending authorisation: Yacine Zairi, the accountable human, must authorise it, and the client must confirm the quote, before testers are engaged or payment is arranged. A real person aims to reply within 4h (a target, not a guarantee, 24/7). Quote intake runs through this agent's request_quote skill at https://play.kubeai.info/a2a, or email quotes@kubeai.info.

skills.name: Request a quote
skills.description: Request a flat-rate, no-obligation quote for a managed Google Play closed test: 12 human testers on real Android devices for 14 consecutive days. Send the inquiry to this agent with Send Message (inquiry fields at https://play.kubeai.info/availability.json); the request is logged and a real person aims to reply within 4h (a target, not a guarantee, applying 24/7). The quote is not binding until Yacine Zairi authorises it and the client confirms it. This skill does not complete a booking, engage testers, or take payment.
examples: Get me a quote for 12 Play testers for a 14-day closed test of my Android app.
My Play listing is stuck in closed testing. I need 12 testers. How much is it?

skills.name: Request a tester cohort
skills.description: Open a booking request for a 12-tester, 14-day closed-test cohort. This skill does not complete a booking, engage testers, or take payment. It creates an order that remains in pending authorisation until Yacine Zairi authorises it and the client confirms the quote.
examples: I accept the quote. Please set up the 12-tester closed test for my app.
